meta.title: Working note
meta.description: Pins this session’s working context above the composer: the git worktree and its added/deleted lines, every port opened for manual testing with a guarded Kill all, and hands-on steps the agent or you pin. Stored on the Host, so the note survives reloads and follows you to every device connected to the same Harness; after the session is archived it is kept for a 30-second undo window and then removed with it. Click a port chip to open it; right-click highlighted chat text and choose “Pin note”, or press Alt+Shift+P, to add a step. Turning the plugin off removes the strip, its sidebar tab, and the working_note tool, while the stored note stays until its session is archived.
